# Handle missing numeric state after optional chaining explicitly

473 refreshed the selected-message counter when changing folders;477 fixed the missing-view case. gDBView?.getSelectedMsgHdrs().length may be undefined, and undefined<2 is false. Current code explicitly hides the counter for undefined or fewer than two selected messages. Preserve the no-view contract rather than shorten it to a numeric comparison.

Scope: mail/base/content.
